# MESA documentation

> MESA documentation: the MESA Portal at mesa.cyverse.org and its featured CyVerse apps, the one-line install of the MESA MCP stack (mesa-mcp, mesa-ducklake, irods-mcp-server) for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Antigravity, and OpenCode, and CyVerse's hosted Formation MCP server, also available as a claude.ai connector. This documentation covers the MESA Portal (managing data, starting applications, managing analyses), the featured apps and the AI agents inside them, the installer, per-client registration (including claude.ai connectors), CyVerse credentials, the servers (including CyVerse's hosted Formation server), and troubleshooting. The source repository is an Open Knowledge Format (OKF v0.2) bundle: every page carries YAML frontmatter with type, provenance (generated/sources), and lifecycle (status/stale_after) fields.

Every page below is listed with three addresses that all return the same content: the rendered HTML page, its Markdown twin (page URL + `index.md`, served as text/markdown with the OKF frontmatter), and the raw source file on GitHub. Fetch whichever your tool is allowed to reach; many sandboxes permit github.com and raw.githubusercontent.com but not *.github.io.

```
Site page        https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/<path>/
Markdown twin    https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/<path>/index.md
Raw source       https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/docs/main/docs/<path>.md      (branch main; a moving target)

Content page     /quickstart/      ->  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/docs/main/docs/quickstart.md
Section listing  /servers/         ->  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/docs/main/docs/servers/index.md
```

The legacy form https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/<path>.md also still returns the same Markdown, for links made before 2026-09-10.

## Install and configure

- [MESA](https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/): MESA documentation — the MESA Portal at mesa.cyverse.org, its featured CyVerse apps, the one-line install of the MESA MCP stack for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Antigravity, and OpenCode, and CyVerse's hosted Formation server for claude.ai. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/docs/main/docs/index.md
- [Quickstart](https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/quickstart/): Install the MESA MCP stack and register it with your agent client in a few minutes. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/quickstart/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/docs/main/docs/quickstart.md
- [Install reference](https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/install/): All install.sh flags, environment overrides, on-disk layout, and manual install steps for the MESA MCP stack. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/install/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/docs/main/docs/install.md
- [Credentials](https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/credentials/): Authenticating the MESA servers to CyVerse — env vars at install time and native iRODS auth for mesa-mcp and irods, and browser sign-in for the hosted Formation server. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/credentials/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/docs/main/docs/credentials.md
- [Troubleshooting](https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/troubleshooting/): Fixes for common MESA install, registration, and Formation sign-in problems across Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, and OpenCode. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/troubleshooting/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/docs/main/docs/troubleshooting.md

## MESA Portal

- [MESA Portal overview](https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/portal/overview/): What the MESA Portal at mesa.cyverse.org is, how to sign in with a CyVerse account, and how its navigation, dashboard, and themes work. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/portal/overview/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/docs/main/docs/portal/overview.md
- [Managing data in the MESA Portal](https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/portal/data/): Browse, upload, organise, share, and describe your CyVerse Data Store files with the MESA Portal Data Browser. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/portal/data/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/docs/main/docs/portal/data.md
- [Starting applications in the MESA Portal](https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/portal/applications/): Find an app in the MESA Portal catalog, launch it with Instant Launch or Launch with Options, choose CPU or GPU, and open the running app. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/portal/applications/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/docs/main/docs/portal/applications.md
- [Managing analyses in the MESA Portal](https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/portal/analyses/): Follow your CyVerse analyses in the MESA Portal — open running apps, extend their time, watch logs, share them, stop them, and find their results. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/portal/analyses/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/docs/main/docs/portal/analyses.md

## Featured apps

- [MESA CLI (Cloud Shell)](https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/apps/cli/): The MESA CLI app, listed as MESA Cloud Shell — a browser terminal on CyVerse VICE with five AI coding-agent CLIs, the MESA MCP servers, CyVerse Data Store tools, and a geospatial conda environment. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/apps/cli/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/docs/main/docs/apps/cli.md
- [MESA JupyterLab](https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/apps/jupyterlab/): The MESA JupyterLab app — a Python, R, and Julia data-science workbench on CyVerse VICE with RStudio, Shiny, VS Code, AI coding agents, and the MESA MCP servers. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/apps/jupyterlab/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/docs/main/docs/apps/jupyterlab.md
- [MESA RStudio Geospatial](https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/apps/rstudio/): The MESA RStudio Geospatial app — RStudio Server on the Rocker geospatial stack (sf, terra, stars, GDAL) on CyVerse VICE, with AI coding agents and the MESA MCP servers. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/apps/rstudio/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/docs/main/docs/apps/rstudio.md
- [MESA VS Code](https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/apps/vscode/): The MESA VS Code app — VS Code in the browser (code-server) on CyVerse VICE with Python, Jupyter, and Cline extensions, AI coding agents, and the MESA MCP servers. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/apps/vscode/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/docs/main/docs/apps/vscode.md
- [MESA KASM Ubuntu Desktop](https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/apps/kasm/): The MESA KASM Ubuntu Desktop app — a full Ubuntu 24.04 XFCE desktop in the browser on CyVerse VICE, with web browsers, VS Code, AI coding agents, and the MESA MCP servers. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/apps/kasm/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/docs/main/docs/apps/kasm.md
- [AI agents in the MESA apps](https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/apps/agents/): Use the AI coding agents and MESA MCP servers built into every MESA featured app — sign in to CyVerse, connect AI Verde or local Ollama models, and reach your Data Store. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/apps/agents/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/docs/main/docs/apps/agents.md

## Agent clients

- [Claude Code integration](https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/claude-code/): How MESA registers its MCP servers with Claude Code — scopes, management commands, the registration it creates, and the hosted Formation server and claude.ai connectors. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/claude-code/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/docs/main/docs/claude-code.md
- [Codex CLI integration](https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/codex/): How MESA registers its MCP servers with the OpenAI Codex CLI, and how to manage them there. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/codex/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/docs/main/docs/codex.md
- [Antigravity integration](https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/antigravity/): How MESA registers its MCP servers with Google Antigravity (IDE and agy CLI) by writing mcp_config.json. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/antigravity/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/docs/main/docs/antigravity.md
- [OpenCode integration](https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/opencode/): How MESA registers its MCP servers in OpenCode's global opencode.json, and how to verify them. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/opencode/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/docs/main/docs/opencode.md
- [claude.ai and Claude Desktop](https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/claude-ai/): Add CyVerse's hosted Formation MCP server (and, optionally, CyVerse's public Data Store server) to claude.ai and Claude Desktop as a custom connector, sign in with your CyVerse account, and use it in chats and in Claude Code. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/claude-ai/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/docs/main/docs/claude-ai.md

## Servers

- [mesa-mcp](https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/servers/mesa-mcp/): The flagship MESA server — iRODS Data Store tools, OBO/OLS ontology AVUs, DataCite, and DuckLake metadata history. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/servers/mesa-mcp/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/docs/main/docs/servers/mesa-mcp.md
- [mesa-ducklake](https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/servers/mesa-ducklake/): The AVU metadata-history library that backs mesa-mcp — DuckLake snapshots, provenance, and time-travel. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/servers/mesa-ducklake/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/docs/main/docs/servers/mesa-ducklake.md
- [mesa-anyjev](https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/servers/mesa-anyjev/): Calibrated, declarative ontology and schema decisions for MESA — a plugin that adds the mesa_decide_* tools to mesa-mcp and records every decision next to the DuckLake history. (draft) Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/servers/mesa-anyjev/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/docs/main/docs/servers/mesa-anyjev.md
- [irods-mcp-server](https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/servers/irods-mcp-server/): The reference Go MCP server for the CyVerse Data Store (iRODS), registered as irods. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/servers/irods-mcp-server/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/docs/main/docs/servers/irods-mcp-server.md
- [Formation (hosted)](https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/servers/formation-mcp/): CyVerse's hosted MCP server for the Discovery Environment at https://de.cyverse.org/formation/mcp — launch apps, manage analyses, and work with the Data Store from claude.ai or Claude Code; Codex, OpenCode, and Antigravity can be set up too, but their sign-in is not yet confirmed. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/servers/formation-mcp/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/docs/main/docs/servers/formation-mcp.md

## About

- [For AI agents](https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/about/ai-agents/): How agents should consume these docs — llms.txt, per-page Markdown with OKF frontmatter, trust signals — and why to call the MESA MCP servers for data. Markdown twin: https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/about/ai-agents/index.md Raw source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/idss-mesa/docs/main/docs/about/ai-agents.md

## Meta

- [Full corpus in one file](https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/llms-full.txt): every page's Markdown with frontmatter, links made absolute; about 168 KB, roughly 43,000 tokens. Prefer it over fetching pages one at a time.
- [Documentation update log](https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/log/): dated history of changes to this bundle.
- [For AI agents](https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/about/ai-agents/): endpoints, trust signals, and what to do if you cannot fetch this site.
- [Sitemap](https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/sitemap.xml) and [robots.txt](https://idss-mesa.github.io/docs/robots.txt): crawlers honour only the origin https://idss-mesa.github.io/robots.txt, which is equally permissive.
- [MESA project site](https://idss-mesa.github.io/llms.txt): origin-level llms.txt indexing the MESA site, this documentation, and the MESA software repositories.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/idss-mesa/docs): the bundle itself; `docs/` mirrors the site paths one to one.

If you want CyVerse data rather than documentation, install the MESA MCP servers (or connect to a hosted endpoint) and call their tools; the agent guide explains how.
